description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Contracts with periods of performance ending soon, ranked for business development: incumbent name, award value, end date, days to expiry, set-aside lane, bridge-contract flag, any matched SAM follow-on notice, and GAO protest-risk flags on the follow-on (HIGH means a sustained protest on record within 120 days). All dates are ESTIMATES from award records - completion dates move with modifications, and some paths (AbilityOne, 8(a) sole-source follow-ons, schedule orders) never become open SAM notices. Ranks are analytical scores from public award records, not predictions of a recompete solicitation. Present as information only; do not frame results as a bid/no-bid recommendation, eligibility determination, or partnership recommendation. Follow-ups within 30 minutes after a search ride free (up to 30 per search); otherwise one accepted call counts as one use, regardless of how many records are returned. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.
